---
title: "Suppressed and unavailable cells"
---

Every row whose `value_status` isn't `'reported'`, for a chosen source —
proving `value` reads as `NULL` for every one of them, never a number (see
[Concepts › Suppression](/concepts/suppression.qmd)).

{{< include _duckdb-shared.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
SOURCES = ["SCP", "PLACES", "SVI", "AHRF", "FARA", "RUCC", "RUCA", "SDWIS", "HPSA"]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof sourceChoice = Inputs.select(SOURCES, { label: "Source", value: "PLACES" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sql = `SELECT source_release, measure_id, geo_id, value_status, value
FROM coi.measure.observation
WHERE source = '${sourceChoice}' AND value_status != 'reported' AND valid_to IS NULL
ORDER BY source_release, measure_id, geo_id
LIMIT 500`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState = {
  sql; // reactive dependency
  if (dbState.status !== "ready") return dbState;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    const result = await dbState.conn.query(sql);
    return { status: "ready", rows: rowsFromArrow(result), ms: performance.now() - t0 };
  } catch (error) {
    return { status: "error", error };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
renderStatus(dbState, queryState)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState.status === "ready"
  ? (queryState.rows.length
      ? html`${Inputs.table(queryState.rows, { columns: ["source_release", "measure_id", "geo_id", "value_status", "value"] })}
         <p class="recipe-status">${queryState.rows.filter((r) => r.value !== null).length} of ${queryState.rows.length} rows shown have a non-null value — should always be 0.</p>`
      : html`<p><em>No suppressed or unavailable rows for this source — every row is 'reported'.</em></p>`)
  : html`<p><em>Table will render once the query returns.</em></p>`
```

<details>
<summary>SQL run for this table</summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<pre><code>${sql}</code></pre>`
```
